>The "Hot" sorting is confusing

This is something I wrote about here: right now after the ranking value becomes less than some predefined value re-ranking stops, so all threads like that become randomly sorted.

Or on the second thought maybe they meant the peculiarity of HN ranking algo: a score of 1 is basically the same as a score of 0 or a score of -1, so new threads are pretty much invisible (i.e. ranked after all threads with score of 2 and more regardless of age) until someone upvotes them.
I changed this just a few minutes ago, sorting by rank is unchanged but there is now also a 'by date' aspect to it, favoring newer posts if 2 posts have same rank but different submission dates.

If you are ready for change, then you can contemplate replacing (score - 1) with (score) in ranking formula, making it more like reddit (submissions with score 1 will go right to the front page, and with score 0 and lower will behave like submissions with score 1 now).
